reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's September 30 factsheet page 2 gives the complete asset-class allocation: Other Money Market Instrument 56.54%, Time Deposit 2.87%, Cash and Cash Equivalent 40.59%, totaling 100.00% without normalization. Page 1 reports pooled USD sub-fund size of USD 567.81 million and identifies Class I USD, ISIN HK0001153516, alongside the other participating share classes. The issuer publication index lists this exact English factsheet with September 30 report date and October 20 upload. These are pooled category weights, not current token supply or an independently audited Class I-only denominator. Historical June accounts and October workbooks are not joined into this snapshot. The September 14 prospectus, USD sub-fund printed page 160, prohibits purchasing instruments with remaining maturity above 397 days except Government and other Public Securities; the exception cannot apply to bank time deposits, so their governing maximum remains 397 days. The September WAM of 38.21 days is an average, not a maximum. No maximum is assigned to the mixed Other Money Market Instrument bucket because permitted money-market fund shares and the public-security exception require constituent-level scope.
